messages.author: e66bc079e31acd98
messages.subject: Authentication failure
parts:
Hello dear google group,

first of all, I am massively impressed, what is possible, using shiny. At the moment I am attending an internship at a company and I'm trying to set up shiny-server for internal use. I have access to two different servers.
I have to say, that I am not quite familiar with server architecture and stuff like this.
On one server, which runs Ubuntu 12.04, I got shiny-server working.
The other server, where I would prefer to get shiny-server running, is a windows machine, running Ubuntu 14.04 in a virtual machine (at least that's how I understood it)
I configured both shiny-servers equally, but on the second server, it won't work.
Going to <server>:3838 gets me to the shiny server welcome page, meaning in general it works, right?
But unfortunately, where the shiny app should appear, I get the error:

An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

The application exited during initialization.

Password: su: Authentication failure


Do you have an idea where the problem is?

I know, that these might not be enough information for you, but at the moment I'm neither sure, nor experienced enough to know, which information to provide. I would, of course, provide any information needed.


Any help would be appreciated

Version of Shiny Server:

shiny-server --version
Shiny Server v1.4.0.721
Node.js v0.10.21

# Instruct Shiny Server to run applications as the user "shiny"
run_as timonh;

# Define a server that listens on port 3838
server {
  listen 3838;

  # Define a location at the base URL
  location / {

    # Host the directory of Shiny Apps stored in this directory
    site_dir /srv/shiny-server;

    # Log all Shiny output to files in this directory

    # When a user visits the base URL rather than a particular application,

Error log: see attached file.

I tried several different users for the "run_as" in the config file. This is now the same setting as on the other server, where I made it working.
I hope these information help to clarify the problem.
Thanks for your help in advance,

Sorry for not being clear. The shiny version, config and error log that I posted is from the server, where it doesn't work (lets call it server 2).

On the other server, where it works (call it server 1), I have exactly the same settings. In both cases, I have specified the same user (timonh). This user has the same privileges and group affiliances on both servers, so it should not be an invalid user, and also the respective folders belong to this user.
Furthermore I tried with the user "shiny" and "root", as well as with one in the "su" group, so I don't quite get, why it should be an authentication failure.

The only differences between the servers is the system, I think. Server 1 is an Ubuntu 12.04 machine, while Server 2 is Ubuntu Server 14.04, running in a VM on a windows machine. Could that cause the problem or was it rather a false assumption that using the same user, with same privileges and group affiliances should end up in the same "behaviour"?
